Standard Errors and Intervals From a Link-Scale Variance Matrix

Source: R/fit_distrib.R
fit_inference.Rd

Carries a variance matrix of the estimates on the link scale to the quantities that a fit stores and reports: the variance matrix on the parameter scale by the delta method, the standard errors on both scales and the Wald intervals, which are symmetric on the link scale and mapped through the inverse links.

Usage

fit_inference(distrib, eta, V_eta, level)

Arguments

distrib

The fitted distrib object.

eta

The estimates on the link scale.

V_eta

The variance matrix on the link scale, named by the parameters; entries are NA where it could not be computed.

level

The confidence level of the intervals.

Value

A list with the components vcov, vcov_eta, se, se_eta, ci and ci_eta, laid out as the properties of the same names in distrib_fit().

See also

fit_distrib(), which stores the result for the observed information; vcov.distrib_fit(), which recomputes it for another matrix.
